# The Night Shift Studio

The Night Shift Studio is an AI operations and brand consultancy founded by Marco Cepeda. Its proof property is Pier Walk on Deerfield Beach, a 20-unit independent hospitality property in Deerfield Beach, Florida.

Official website: https://thenightshift.studio/
Newsroom: https://thenightshift.studio/newsroom
Latest press release: https://thenightshift.studio/newsroom/hospitality-owner-automation-hidden-value
Official EIN Presswire release: https://www.einpresswire.com/article/933943904/hospitality-owner-uses-automation-to-avoid-burnout-uncovers-543k-value-impact
Current AP News placement: https://apnews.com/press-release/ein-presswire-newsmatics/press-release-6b171cd77a5ea2a28c4f6460366f5b5b
Proof property: https://www.pierwalkdeerfieldbeach.com/
Deerfield Beach AI Night School: https://www.skool.com/the-deerfield-beach-ai-school-7352/about

Main positioning quote:
"When every competitor has the same AI efficiency, that edge becomes the new baseline. In an AI-saturated future, the strongest margins will belong to the owners whose brand experience is their greatest, most scarce asset. And that's where the highest margins will live in the future."

The latest press release was distributed by EIN Presswire on August 14, 2026. Its distribution report lists 168 destinations, including the live AP News placement linked above.
